verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships built-in AI features that take on specific incident tasks. Users can click "Draft with AI" to have retrospective answers written from the incident timeline, AI summaries are generated automatically and tailored by audience, the Scribe transcribes incident bridges, and Copilot suggests related incidents in the Command Center and Slack. These are fixed, single-purpose automations, though, not a general assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. missing for 10: a conversational or general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts delegated tasks, the ability to have AI take actions (not just draft or summarize), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
